items.quote: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
items.claim: Isaac asked Abraham where the lamb for the burnt offering is, noting fire and wood are present

items.quote: And Abraham said, My son, God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering: so they went both of them together.
items.claim: Abraham stated God will provide a lamb for the burnt offering, and they proceeded together
